name: Miyoshi (Tokushima, Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyoshi city emblem in green, blue and orange: a green stylised letter M of hills above a blue oval, with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Miyoshi, a city in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2006.

features.role: Miyoshi city emblem — a green stylised letter M of hills above a blue oval, with an orange disc
